# war -- one row per war that ended.
#
# Replaces balance_war_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 4,043 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="war_w"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (268), each a map of its own:
#     w        <- scope:winner
#     l        <- scope:loser
#     end      <- current_date
#     len      <- global_var:war_len_v
#     cb       <- global_var:war_pending_cb
#     atk      <- scope:war.original_attacker_leader
#     def      <- scope:war.original_defender_leader
#     aw       <- scope:winner.var:shadow_attr
#     al       <- scope:loser.var:shadow_attr
#     obj      <- scope:war
#     pan      <- global_var:wpan

war_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = war_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = war_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = war_count add = 1 }

	# a script value, not a target -- a map takes targets only
	set_global_variable = { name = war_len_v value = { value = scope:war.war_length min = 0 } }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_w key = global_var:war_count value = scope:winner }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_l key = global_var:war_count value = scope:loser }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_end key = global_var:war_count value = current_date }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_len key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:war_len_v }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_cb key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:war_pending_cb }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_atk key = global_var:war_count value = scope:war.original_attacker_leader }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_def key = global_var:war_count value = scope:war.original_defender_leader }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_aw key = global_var:war_count value = scope:winner.var:shadow_attr }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_al key = global_var:war_count value = scope:loser.var:shadow_attr }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_obj key = global_var:war_count value = scope:war }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pan key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpan }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa0 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa0 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa1 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa1 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa2 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa2 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa3 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa3 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa4 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa4 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa5 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa5 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa5 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa5 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa6 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa6 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_pa7 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wpa7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = war_qa7 key = global_var:war_count value = global_var:wqa7 }
